cause_quote: The new runtime selector used `.filter((variant) => !variant.nativeRuntime || variant.nativeRuntime === params.runtimeId)`, allowing an API catalog entry to supply the displayed limit when the selected native runtime had no matching entry.
user_saw: After discovery, a refresh, or a runtime switch, status and session reports could show an old context limit, another runtime’s limit, or a generic 200,000-token limit.
summary: The fix makes status and session reports use current, runtime-scoped catalog capacity, configured caps, or a matching verified run budget, and show unknown when capacity is unavailable.
reasoning: The introducing diff added cross-runtime catalog selection and wired the selected entry into Gateway session rows, where I verified that its context tokens fed the displayed limit. The wrong-runtime limit was therefore possible from the feature’s first commit. The fix also addresses stale-cache and CLI fallback paths, whose original introduction I could not verify from the available offline history.
